reportOnlyUntil: Drew's review - no apply is authorized by this PR
finding: #1899 census (2026-09-06): baseballcardpedia rows whose cardNumber is not a card number but the first token of a split card line -- e.g. 1998 SP Authentic cardNumber 'Gary' / playerName 'Sheffield 5 X 7 JSY 125' at hiq:baseball:1998:sp-authentic:gary:base:no-auto.
rulings: THE PREDICATE IS THE SPLIT, NOT 'NO DIGIT'. A first pass on 'cardNumber contains no digit' selected 79 rows in 1998 sp-authentic alone and was WRONG: PM (Paul Molitor), KG (Ken Griffey Jr.), GS, AJ and RL are the product's own INITIALS numbering and are correct rows. The damage has its own signature -- a capitalised GIVEN NAME in cardNumber with the rest of the name, plus the line's trailing description, spilled into playerName. Only that shape is listed here.

A SECOND OVER-FIRE WAS ALSO REJECTED. A 'description junk in the number' rule matched 5,321 rows whose numbers were AW-15, HG-463, DK-20, SOF-RC -- ordinary insert numbering whose prefixes happen to contain the letters SP/RC/BAT. Those rows are NOT in this list; the substring rule was withdrawn rather than shipped.

A TWIN IS THE SAME CARD, NOT THE SAME PLAYER. A player-only match proposed 223 retires including 'Derek Jeter' -> #3 :refractor:, 'Alex Rodriguez' -> #4 :gold: and 'Cal Ripken Jr.' -> #4C -- different rungs and a different number, i.e. 167 rows would have been retired onto a card they are not. The twin test used here demands same sport/year/setKey AND same parallel AND same isAuto AND the same grade segment, and it refuses when more than one candidate matches. That leaves 56 twins out of 721.

RETIRE IS A DELETE in this lane (catalogVisibility.ts:23-25 - every state is matchable, only visibility is tiered), and retireCatalogRow re-points nothing. The cost is normally that the retired row's sales become unplaced; here that cost is ZERO -- see the census.

NO SALES ARE AT RISK. Every one of the 721 slugs was point-counted in sold_comps on BOTH c.hobbyiqCardId and c.cardId: all zero. The query form was proved live on the same run (':sp-authentic:' returns 15,356 sales, ':this:' returns 0), so the zero is a measurement and not a broken query. There is therefore NO companion pool list for this finding.

THE 665 WITHOUT A TWIN ARE NOT RETIRED. 443 of them are not cards at all -- 192 carry cardNumber 'This' and playerName 'page was last edited on <date>', the baseballcardpedia page FOOTER scraped as a card line; the rest are parallel/insert headings ('Printing Plates', 'Framed White Refractor', 'Sparkle (common)') and prose. The other 222 are person-shaped rows that are the ONLY row for that identity, so retiring them would lose the card. Both groups are DEFERRED, not actioned: this lane has no park action (classifyEntry accepts 'retire' and 'reslug' only, relocate-catalog-rows-by-list.cjs:151-152), and identityUnverified is a sold_comps field with no card_catalog equivalent. They are listed in `deferred` with reasons and NOTHING is minted for them.

PRIOR ART, UNMERGED. Commit 78aa88bf ('a page footer is not a card - 17 wiki-scrape rows retired') retired this exact footer shape, but it is NOT on main -- it sits on fix/derive-builds-search-fields-0901-0150. The 192 footer rows measured here are still live.

census.scope: baseball, 13 years (1993-2005) x the products baseballcardpedia scraped; each slice read partition-bounded on sport+year+setKey. No unbounded cross-partition query was run.
census.note: measured read-only 2026-09-06; every count above is from the run that produced this file

scraperStatus.why:
Both scrapers now REQUIRE a digit in the number token. scrape-baseballcardpedia.cjs matches every card line with /^([A-Z]{0,4}\d{1,4}[A-Za-z]?)[.)\s:]+([A-Za-z].{2,150})$/ (the

,

  • and paths all share the shape), and 'Gary Sheffield 5 X 7 JSY 125' does not match it. scrape-bcp-ladders.cjs gates on CARD_NUM /^([A-Z]{0,4}-?\d+[a-z]?|[A-Z0-9]{1,6}-[A-Z0-9]{1,6})$/i and CARD_LINE, both of which reject 'Gary'; its letters-only BASE_INITIALS_NUM /^[A-Z]{2,4}$/ is upper-case-only and 2-4 chars, so it rejects 'Gary' too. Verified by running the live regexes against the damaged strings.
scraperStatus.residualDefectNotFixedHere: scrape-baseballcardpedia.cjs still splits at the FIRST digit-led token, so a line that LEADS with description ('5 X 7 JSY 125 Gary Sheffield') yields cardNumber '5' and playerName 'X 7 JSY 125 Gary Sheffield'. That is a live shape, distinct from the one listed here, and it is NOT fixed in this PR: the fix is to reject a candidate player name that still carries description tokens (JSY/BAT/BALL/'N X N'/a bare print run) and to skip the line rather than mint it. Separate PR.

poolList: NONE - zero sales point at any of the 721 slugs, so no pool-relocations companion is needed.
